definition: Anarthria is loss of speech articulation, or very severe difficulty producing clear speech, especially when tongue movement is impaired. In this historical source it is described as a muscular, peripheral speech defect, seen for example in bulbar paralysis, rather than a disorder involving central aphasic symptoms.
